exact.Hoy y a cada fin de mes, el mejor {aaInd: Today and at each month end, the best {aaIndexName} published up to that date by labs of each country, or by closed-weight and open-weight models, and the difference between them; the top two labs, with each one’s best model. Lab country and weights follow the observatory’s catalogue: a model counts as open if its OpenRouter description presents it as open-weight, even if it cannot yet be downloaded. This is a reconstruction made today, not a series measured at each date: each model is placed at its date according to AA, with today’s index, and only the {n} in the catalogue count (those still on OpenRouter and those AA already scores without a public API), so retired models are missing in the older months.{coverageText} The distances are not converted into months, and the AA and ECI scales are not comparable. Data from {AA_LINK}, published with its permission.
exact.Para cada fin de mes, el mejor ECI publi: For each month end, the best ECI published up to that date by organisations of each country (or with closed and open weights, according to Epoch’s classification), and the difference between them. Epoch treats two models less than 1 point apart as having the same capability. Epoch scores models weeks after they come out and does not measure some labs: that is why its figures lag behind those above. The probability on each card comes from the bootstrap replicates Epoch publishes: it repeats the entire fit by resampling each model’s results, and counts in how many replicates the leader stays ahead. The distances are not converted into months. Source:

exact.«{sub}» no está en el catálogo: puede qu: “{sub}” is not in the catalogue: OpenRouter may no longer list it, it may belong to a lab that is not tracked, or it may be more than {dias} days old.
exact.«API pública» es la fecha de alta en Ope: “Public API” is the date of listing on OpenRouter, which may be later than the lab’s own API. “Scored by AA, no public API” is the day the observatory first saw its Artificial Analysis score while it was not on OpenRouter. “Downloadable weights” is the date the repository was created on Hugging Face. “Restricted access” is a phase in which only selected organisations or people could use it; “Lab products only”, a phase in which it could be used in the lab’s apps or subscriptions but not through the API. Announcements and these two phases are on record when they have been logged by hand with a link to the primary source (the lab’s blog, documentation or repository); if no announcement is logged, the release date from Epoch AI’s model database is used. Stages with no data are grouped under “Not on record”.
exact.Líderes calculados entre los modelos del: Leaders calculated among the catalogue models with a score in the {aaIndexName}: those that can be used through the API on OpenRouter and those AA already scores even though they have no public API yet, marked “no public API”. Data from {AA_LINK}, published with its permission. For each model, the reasoning configuration with the highest index is used. Comparable-capability threshold: the best model’s index minus the chosen number of points. Blended price: (3 × input + output) / 4, using the price charged by the lab itself on OpenRouter or, if it does not serve the model, that of the cheapest provider, which is indicated.
